Cake Flour Crust
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:43am

Ingredients




1 cup cake flour
1/8 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup butter
1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
1/2 cup sugar
2 eggs
3 teaspoons milk

Preparation

1 Sift together flour and salt. Set aside. Cream together butter, vanilla and sugar until light and fluffy. Stir in the eggs and milk; beat well. Butter a 9 inch springform pan and lightly press crust on the bottom. Set aside.
